title_as_printed: Gas phase water content ppm (mol) in a synthetic natural gas mixture with composition 84.4 mol% methane, 10.0 mol% ethane, 4.0 mol% propane, 0.6 mol% iso-butane and 1.0 mol% n-butane
pressure_note: absolute system pressure (saturator and condenser at same pressure), measured by transducer, uncertainty 0.05 bar; printed in column headers; value is water mole fraction in the gas phase in equilibrium with liquid water, ice or hydrate (most stable phase), pressure basis total

P.constant: set per block by label row

composition.other_species: salt-free pure water phase; gas composition: ch4-c2h6-c3h8-i-c4h10-n-c4h10

notes: Printed as a wide table (T rows x pressure columns). Stacked into one block per pressure column (label row = column header), as SPEC rule 11 prescribes; '-' cells (no measurement) are not written as rows. Rows with T<273.15 K are ice-equilibrium (or metastable liquid) conditions: below_273K. Hydrate may be the stable condensed phase for methane at some conditions; paper does not tag individual points, so regime left empty. Table 2 header '140' printed without 'bar' (taken as bar). Temperature is the condenser dew-point bath temperature. Gas is a synthetic mixture, composition in title.
